text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, my trainee and I will be
taking on
the Twinkle Series. The
Umamusume joining me
for this journey
is none other than...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
My name? Gold City. ...Do you need
anything
else from me?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...I may be a model, but I've come to this

academy to run. And I want to use these
legs to
show the world... my own kind of
running.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I'll send you packing if you
treat me like
I'm just some pretty face.
Don't forget that,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, <chrname> and I
take our
first steps towards competing in
the Twinkle
Series!
